_provenance.sizing: n=97 chosen by power calculation: the observed paired per-query recall difference has sd 0.308, so detecting the observed 0.088 effect at 80% power requires 97 queries. The first evaluation used 30 and could not resolve it (95% CI [-0.199, +0.014], p=0.132).
_provenance.pool_depth: Top 10 from each of Skip-gram, FastText and TF-IDF, then de-duplicated. Depth matches the evaluation cut-off (k=10); the first evaluation pooled at depth 8 while scoring at 10, so ranks 9-10 could go unjudged and depress recall.
_provenance.method: Read the title and abstract of every pooled candidate and judged whether the trial's subject matter substantively addresses the query. Judgements are filtered to the pool, so a carried-forward label outside the depth-10 pool is discarded.
_provenance.decision_rule: Relevant = the trial studies the queried topic, not merely mentions the query words. Population-only matches excluded (a vaccine trial whose subjects are dialysis patients is not about 'dialysis in critical illness'). Ambiguous truncated abstracts excluded, which depresses recall equally for every method. Queries were written before any results were seen and were not revised afterwards.

dropped_queries.catching the virus a second time: No reinfection trials in the pooled candidates - every candidate was a mouthwash/viral-load or treatment study. An unlabelled query scores 0 for every method and would read as a retrieval failure rather than a corpus gap, so it is dropped per the rule in load_eval_set.
dropped_queries.how long to quarantine: Every pooled candidate studies the PSYCHOLOGICAL IMPACT of quarantine; none study its DURATION, which is what the query asks. Dropped rather than relabelled, since reinterpreting a query after seeing its results is exactly the bias the protocol exists to prevent.
dropped_queries.how long patients stay infectious: Zero relevant candidates in the pool. NOTE: relevant trials DO exist in the corpus - CHICTR2000031244 (Shedding virus and functional prognosis) and CHICTR2100045849 (how long does the virus exist) were surfaced for OTHER queries - but no method retrieved them for this one. Dropping is correct for scoring, but this is a pooling limitation, not an absence in the corpus, and it means all three methods failed this query equally.

known_bias: The labeller also authored the retrieval system being evaluated.
Recall is measured against the pool, not the whole 10,666-document corpus - the standard TREC pooling caveat. It inflates absolute recall equally for every pooled method.

'how long patients stay infectious' was dropped for having no relevant candidate, yet relevant trials demonstrably exist in the corpus (they surfaced under other queries). No method retrieved them. Dropping is right for scoring but hides a shared failure.
Some queries are deliberately strict, e.g. 'oxygen therapy at home' counts only home/outpatient oxygen. Every method scores low on those by design.
_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL. Supersede with independent human judgements before quoting externally.

queries.note: Excluded 2021-000988-68 (renal failure) and CHICTR2000030014 (lung rehabilitation, not failure).
Excluded breathing exercises aimed at stress or sleep quality rather than dyspnea, and intubation-procedure difficulty.
All pooled candidates were genuine ARDS trials.
No trial addresses weaning specifically, so judged on ventilation management/liberation. Drug trials that merely enrol ventilated patients were excluded.
Deliberately strict: 'at home' excludes ICU high-flow and in-hospital oxygen titration. A hard query by design; all methods should score low.
Excluded myocardial injury, acute lung injury, and a kidney-transplant vaccination study.
Excluded general ICU trials with no renal-replacement focus, and vaccination studies whose population happens to be dialysis patients.
All 17 pooled candidates were immunogenicity studies.
Excluded pure safety/efficacy trials with no humoral endpoint. NCT04910295 measures explicitly after the second dose.
Requires both immunocompromise and vaccination. Excluded healthy-cohort vaccine studies and transplant infection studies with no vaccine component.
All 18 concern thrombosis or anticoagulation.
Excluded pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary vascular leak and cardiac-imaging studies that share the word 'pulmonary' or 'cardiovascular' but not embolism.
Requires a treatment. Purely observational cytokine-measurement studies excluded.
Requires a corticosteroid. Many pooled candidates were other anti-inflammatories (tocilizumab, pentoxifylline, melatonin) and were excluded.
Excluded prophylaxis trials and an adverse-effect (liver dysfunction) study.
Requires a viral-load or viral-clearance endpoint. Excluded three near-identical Siddha-medicine trials with no virological endpoint.
Excluded NCT04497246 (acute-phase psychological impact and sleep, not post-COVID fatigue).
Excluded NCT04714892 (taste and smell in obesity, not COVID) and general neuro-rehabilitation.
Excluded NCT04448704 (migrant workers, not healthcare) and a chemoprophylaxis trial whose only link is the HCW population.
All 16 measure or treat pandemic-related anxiety or psychological distress.
Excluded 2021-000893-27 (antibody transfer in breastmilk - lactation, not a pregnancy outcome).
Excluded DRKS00021614 (studies the mothers, not the children) and NCT04884685 (truncated abstract, paediatric status unconfirmed).
Excluded general palliative-care strategy and hospital-isolation studies with no care-home or elderly population.
Requires diabetes specifically. Excluded generic 'risk factor' studies (elderly prognosis, VTE, cardiovascular) that never mention diabetes.
Requires obesity or BMI. Most pooled candidates matched only on 'severe disease' and were excluded - a good discriminating query.
All 13 concern post-acute rehabilitation or recovery.
All 14 concern remote care delivery or monitoring.
All 14 are convalescent plasma trials.

Requires monoclonal antibodies. Excluded convalescent plasma, polyclonal hyperimmune IgG, vaccine-response studies, and antibody assays. Excluded NCT04441918 as the truncated abstract does not confirm a mAb.
Excluded neurological damage, kidney injury and CNS studies pooled on the shared word 'damage'.
